title: LLMProf Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for the manifest.json file that describes a LLMProf WASM plugin.

pluginApiVersionRequirement.description: SemVer requirement for the host plugin API version (e.g. ^1.0.0).

display_name.description: Localized user-facing plugin name (locale primary subtag -> text, e.g. {"en": "Quiz Generator", "de": "Quiz-Generator"}). 1-10 entries, each value 1-500 chars. Include at least an 'en' entry.

description.description: Localized user-facing description (locale primary subtag -> text). Same rules as display_name. The host resolves the entry matching the user's locale (exact -> primary subtag -> en -> alphabetically first).

changelog.description: Optional changelog or release notes for this version. Omit (or send an empty string) when there is nothing worth communicating — the host hides the section instead of rendering placeholder text.

id.description: Unique capability identifier within the plugin.

type.description: Capability type: tool (LLM function calling), command (UI action), or student_support (learning mode strategy).

execute.description: Name of the exported WASM function to call when this capability is invoked.

execution_timeout_ms.description: Maximum execution time in milliseconds. Must not exceed 30000 (MAX_EXECUTION_MS).

host_capabilities.description: Host capabilities this plugin needs to call.

execution_timeout_ms.description: Maximum execution time in milliseconds for the host capability call.

configuration_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the plugin's configuration options. Users provide configuration matching this schema when installing the plugin.

allowed_hosts.description: List of hostnames the plugin is allowed to make outbound HTTP requests to (if network access is granted).

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle hooks for install, upgrade, and uninstall operations.

on_install.description: Name of the exported WASM function called on first install.

on_before_upgrade.description: Name of the exported WASM function called before an upgrade. Receives the old version.

on_after_upgrade.description: Name of the exported WASM function called after an upgrade. Receives the old and new versions.

on_uninstall.description: Name of the exported WASM function called on uninstall. Use for cleanup.

memory.description: Memory configuration for the plugin's WASM instance.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of 64 KB memory pages the plugin can allocate.

preview_images.description: Paths or URLs to preview images shown in the plugin catalog.
